flow: 3. If yes, pick one or more roles (Operator, Manager, Project Manager ...)
4. For each role, answer the kind question (e.g. 'Which machine do you operate?') with options
5. Tick qualifications for that role + common qualifications; upload proofs
6. Employer posts a job with category + role + kind + required qualifications; matching uses these fields
Services are ticked separately under 'What I offer'
